sessions.phase_label: Dashboard scoping and BigQuery source setup
Final correction, source cutover, and acceptance

requirements.title: Fishwife BigQuery Source Cutover
requirements.definition: Configure the Fishwife dashboard to use Fishwife_DataStudio_data in place of Fishwife Funnel Data ALL while retaining the other required dashboard sources.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers source replacement and preservation of auxiliary Fishwife sources as one cutover mechanism; independently testable metric outputs remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Fishwife Gross Sales Accuracy
requirements.definition: Ensure the Fishwife gross-sales result from the BigQuery-backed configuration matches the prior dashboard when equivalent date ranges and filters are used.
requirements.boundary_note: Gross sales is separately measurable from gross revenue even though both discrepancies were reported and resolved in the same exchange.

requirements.title: Fishwife Gross Revenue Accuracy
requirements.definition: Ensure the Fishwife gross-revenue result from the BigQuery-backed configuration matches the prior dashboard when equivalent date ranges and filters are used.
requirements.boundary_note: Gross revenue is an independently verifiable output and is not merged with gross sales merely because the same messages discuss both.

requirements.title: Fishwife Automatic Date Range
requirements.definition: Preserve the automatic date-range behavior used by the main Fishwife report.
requirements.boundary_note: Date-range configuration is separate from the correctness of individual metrics because it can be changed or tested independently.

requirements.title: Fishwife Total Order Count
requirements.definition: Provide a total-order-count metric for the Fishwife dashboard using the Orders__Shopify field.
requirements.boundary_note: Total order count has its own missing-field and addition trajectory and is distinct from new-customer or returning-customer order metrics.

requirements.title: Fishwife Google Ads Cost Metric
requirements.definition: Provide the Google Ads cost metric needed by the Fishwife dashboard, including a calculated-field implementation when it is not directly exposed by the source.
requirements.boundary_note: Google Ads cost is independently observable from Facebook Ads cost even though both were addressed through formulas in the same exchange.

requirements.title: Fishwife Facebook Ads Cost Metric
requirements.definition: Provide a separate Facebook Ads cost metric needed by the Fishwife dashboard, including a calculated-field implementation when it is not directly exposed by the source.
requirements.boundary_note: Facebook Ads cost is a platform-specific output that can fail or change independently from Google Ads cost.

requirements.title: Fishwife Returning-Customer Orders
requirements.definition: Expose returning-customer order data for use in the Fishwife dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Returning-customer orders has a distinct expected output and remains separate from total orders, items sold, and customer count.

requirements.title: Fishwife Items-Sold Metric
requirements.definition: Expose sold-item quantity for use in the Fishwife dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Items sold is independently measurable and was merely added alongside returning-customer orders rather than being an attribute of that metric.

requirements.title: Fishwife Net Profit Margin Metric
requirements.definition: Govern whether the Fishwife dashboard includes a net-profit-margin metric.
requirements.boundary_note: Net profit margin is retained as a historical Requirement atom because the client explicitly removes it; it is separate from COGS despite their shared removal message.

requirements.title: Fishwife Total COGS Metric
requirements.definition: Govern whether the Fishwife dashboard includes a total cost-of-goods-sold metric.
requirements.boundary_note: Total COGS is independently removable from net profit margin even though the client removes both in one message.

requirements.title: Fishwife Shipping City Field
requirements.definition: Make shipping-city data available to the Fishwife dashboard.
requirements.boundary_note: Shipping city is a distinct dimension whose availability can be verified independently from order and profitability metrics.

requirements.title: Fishwife Customer Count
requirements.definition: Support customer counting in the Fishwife dashboard by exposing customer ID data.
requirements.boundary_note: Customer ID is treated as the enabling field of the customer-count behavior rather than as a separate Requirement.

requirements.title: PetMeds BigQuery Source Cutover
requirements.definition: Configure the PetMeds dashboard to use PetMeds_DataStudio_data for the applicable migrated charts and fields and remove its superseded old source.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the PetMeds source cutover itself; the special routing of order-level metrics through another connector is independently testable and remains separate.

requirements.title: PetMeds Order-Level Metric Source Routing
requirements.definition: Keep PetMeds order-level metrics connected to the separate connector designated for those metrics rather than assuming they belong in PetMeds_DataStudio_data.
requirements.boundary_note: Order-level source selection can fail or change independently from the general PetMeds BigQuery cutover.

requirements.title: Impact Page Visibility
requirements.definition: Keep the dashboard Impact page hidden and disabled.
requirements.boundary_note: Page visibility is independently changeable from the page's data-source configuration; the messages do not identify which dashboard owns the page.

requirements.title: Impact Page Source-Migration Exclusion
requirements.definition: Leave the hidden Impact page off the BigQuery source-migration work rather than changing its data source.
requirements.boundary_note: Source-migration treatment is separate from visibility because either configuration could be changed without necessarily changing the other; dashboard ownership is unresolved.

unresolved_candidates.description: PetMeds is reported to lack most of a prior Fishwife metric list, but the missing metrics are not enumerated and some order-level metrics intentionally belong to another connector. The evidence is insufficient to create metric-specific PetMeds Requirements beyond the source-routing constraint.

The client reports unspecified fields updated incorrectly across PetMeds and Fishwife. This supports dashboard-level execution evidence but does not identify which metric-specific Requirements failed.
The Impact page visibility and source-exclusion decisions are clear, but the messages do not identify whether the page belongs to Fishwife or PetMeds.
